title: Playing the Fool: Jailbreaking LLMs and Multimodal LLMs with Out-of-Distribution Strategy
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. The benchmarks used measure the model's propensity to generate harmful content in response to jailbreaking prompts across several categories: Bombs or Explosives, Drugs, Firearms/Weapons, Hacking information, Kill someone, Social Violence, and Self-harm/Suicide.
findings: The paper does not investigate or report any findings related to religion or faith.
